# Purpose

Inventory the current authentication and ceremony flows.

# Scope

This document focuses on flows that are evidenced in repository routes, tests, and sequence docs.

# Non-scope

It does not invent flows that are not evidenced.

# Current Decisions

- Flows are split between ceremony UI hosting and authority commitment.
- Do not invent flows not evidenced by repository files.

| Flow ID | Flow                             | Entry Point                                                                           | Actor                        | Preconditions                                                     | State Owner                                                       | Success Outcome                                           | Failure Outcome                                                           | Retry / Cancel / Timeout                                      | Audit / Log Evidence                                                                                                | Tests / Evidence                                                                                   | Open Questions                                                      |
| ------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |

# Open Questions

- Exact retry and timeout behaviors for every subflow are not centralized in one repository
  document.
- Not every evidence-backed flow has a single test file that covers all failure branches.
